o: A former fake psychic uses his razor-sharp powers of observation to help California investigators close cases while hunting the serial killer who destroyed his family.
A hyper-observant slacker convinces the Santa Barbara police he is psychic and drags his best friend into solving cases with him.
A scientist who reads micro-expressions and body language hires out his talent for spotting lies to the FBI, police and anyone who can pay.
A charming forger trades prison for an ankle monitor and helps the FBI agent who caught him track down white-collar criminals.
A Miami blood-spatter analyst leads a secret double life as a vigilante killer who only targets other murderers.
An FBI profiler with a gift for empathy forms a dangerous bond with a brilliant psychiatrist who is secretly a cannibal killer.
A best-selling mystery novelist shadows a sharp NYPD homicide detective for research and ends up solving murders beside her.
A recovering Sherlock Holmes consults for the NYPD in modern-day New York, with Dr. Joan Watson as his sober companion turned partner.
The death of a young boy tears a close-knit seaside town apart as two mismatched detectives dig through its secrets.
A modern-day Sherlock Holmes and army doctor John Watson tackle London's most baffling crimes, and a nemesis named Moriarty.
A brilliant ex-detective whose phobias cost him his badge consults for the San Francisco police while searching for his wife's killer.
A forensic anthropologist and a cocky FBI agent team up to solve murders from whatever remains are left behind.
The FBI's Behavioral Analysis Unit profiles the country's most dangerous criminals to stop them before they strike again.
In the late 1970s two FBI agents interview imprisoned killers to understand how they think, inventing criminal profiling as they go.
Anthology crime drama in which troubled detectives chase ritualistic murders across years and their own unravelling lives.
A gifted but immature detective and his squad try to keep up with their stern new captain in a Brooklyn precinct.
Bored of ruling Hell, the Devil opens a nightclub in Los Angeles and starts helping an LAPD detective punish the guilty.
A mild chemistry teacher with a terminal diagnosis turns to cooking meth to secure his family's future and slowly becomes someone else.
Years before Breaking Bad, small-time lawyer Jimmy McGill's hustles push him step by step toward becoming Saul Goodman.
A financial planner relocates his family to the Missouri Ozarks to launder money for a cartel after a scheme goes badly wrong.
A mysterious mastermind recruits eight robbers with nothing to lose for a meticulously planned takeover of Spain's Royal Mint.
In post-war Birmingham, the razor-wielding Shelby family claws its way up the criminal underworld under the cold ambition of Tommy Shelby.
DEA agents chase Pablo Escobar and the rise of the Colombian cocaine cartels in this dramatised true story.
d: Chris Brancato, Carlo Bernard & Doug Miro

o: Each season a new tale of ordinary Midwesterners, unlikely criminals and dogged cops spirals out of control in snowy small towns.
A troubled Mumbai cop gets a cryptic call from a legendary gangster warning him to save the city in twenty-five days.
A Delhi police chief and her team race to track down the perpetrators of a horrific crime that shook the nation.
A middle-class father secretly works for an elite intelligence cell, juggling national security with school fees and a suspicious wife.
Two brothers are pulled into the violent empire of Mirzapur's carpet-and-guns kingpin and his volatile son.
A Mumbai stockbroker's meteoric rise and dramatic fall reveal the loopholes behind one of India's biggest financial scandals.
A washed-up Delhi cop lands a high-profile case about a foiled assassination and descends into the country's moral underworld.
A cop on the verge of a break returns to duty when a tourist vanishes in a misty Himalayan town haunted by an old legend.
A retiring detective and his hot-headed replacement hunt a killer whose murders are staged around the seven deadly sins.
A cartoonist, a reporter and a detective become obsessed with identifying the elusive Zodiac killer over decades.
An FBI trainee seeks the help of an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist to catch another serial killer on the loose.
When his daughter goes missing, a desperate father takes the law into his own hands while a detective follows the clues.
A flamboyant detective investigates the death of a wealthy crime novelist whose eccentric family all had a motive.
On his fifth anniversary a man's wife disappears, and the media frenzy turns him into the prime suspect.
An undercover cop and a mole in the police force race to expose each other inside Boston's Irish mob.
A teenage con artist poses as a pilot, doctor and lawyer while a doggedly patient FBI agent chases him across the world.
A smooth ex-con assembles a crew of specialists to rob three Las Vegas casinos in a single night.
The ageing patriarch of a crime dynasty hands control to his reluctant youngest son as war breaks out among New York's families.
Hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers collide in interlocking tales of Los Angeles crime.
A film-obsessed cable operator uses everything he has learned from cinema to shield his family from a relentless police investigation.
A pianist pretending to be blind accidentally witnesses a murder and gets caught in a spiral of lies and double-crosses.
A blood feud between two families in Wasseypur's coal belt rages across three generations of revenge.
A grieving Mumbai police inspector investigating a film star's fatal car crash is drawn into the city's nocturnal underbelly.
A pregnant woman arrives in Kolkata during Durga Puja to search for her missing husband, who no one seems to remember.
In 1980s rural Korea, two mismatched detectives struggle to catch the country's first known serial killer.
A struggling family schemes its way into employment with a wealthy household, until an unexpected discovery upends everything.
Released after fifteen years of unexplained captivity, a man has five days to discover who imprisoned him and why.
A thief who steals secrets from dreams is offered a chance at redemption: plant an idea inside a target's mind.
With Earth dying, a former pilot leads a mission through a wormhole to find humanity a new home, leaving his children behind.
A hacker learns that reality is a simulation run by machines and joins the rebellion fighting to free humanity.
A man who cannot form new memories uses tattoos and Polaroids to hunt his wife's killer, told in reverse.
Two US marshals investigate a disappearance at an island asylum for the criminally insane, where nothing is as it seems.
A linguist races to decode the language of alien visitors before global tensions boil over into war.
A replicant blade runner uncovers a buried secret that could plunge what is left of society into chaos.
The heir of a noble house is thrust into a deadly struggle for the most valuable resource in the universe on a desert planet.
A young programmer is invited to a reclusive CEO's estate to test whether his humanoid AI is truly conscious.
An overwhelmed laundromat owner discovers she must connect with parallel-universe versions of herself to save existence.
When a boy vanishes in a small Indiana town, his friends, family and a strange girl uncover a terrifying secret world.
A child's disappearance exposes the secrets of four families in a German town where time loops every 33 years.
Standalone stories explore the unsettling ways modern technology might twist human nature in the near future.
In a futuristic Wild West theme park, the android hosts begin to awaken to the truth of their existence.
Office workers undergo a procedure that splits their work memories from their personal lives, until the two halves start talking.
Centuries from now, a detective and a rogue ship's crew uncover a conspiracy threatening a fragile peace across the colonised solar system.
Across three generations, a man's greed draws him back to a cursed village and the forbidden treasure of a banished god.
Two engineers tinkering in a garage accidentally build a time machine and lose control of the consequences.
A hitman who kills targets sent back from the future comes face to face with his own older self.
A documentary crew follows the everyday chaos of a paper company's employees and their cringe-inducing regional manager.
An endlessly optimistic small-town bureaucrat and her eccentric colleagues try to make Pawnee, Indiana a better place.
Six friends navigate careers, break-ups and endless coffee in Manhattan through their twenties and thirties.
An upbeat American football coach is hired to manage an English Premier League team despite knowing nothing about the sport.
After losing their fortune, a pampered family is forced to live in the tiny town they once bought as a joke.
A selfish woman wakes up in a heavenly afterlife by mistake and tries to become a better person before anyone notices.
An engineering graduate reluctantly takes a job as secretary of a remote village panchayat and slowly finds his place.
Teenagers in Kota's coaching factories chase engineering dreams under the guidance of a beloved physics teacher.
Warm vignettes from the life of the Mishra family as they bicker, scrimp and love their way through small-town life.
Four friends quit their corporate jobs to chase a startup dream, discovering how messy building something can be.
Three related households of a sprawling, modern family stumble through life's everyday comic disasters.
Three true-crime-obsessed neighbours start a podcast to solve a murder in their posh Manhattan apartment building.
A woman who can always tell when someone is lying hits the road and keeps stumbling into murders only she can solve.
A misanthropic diagnostic genius and his team crack medical mysteries no one else can solve, rules be damned.
A brilliant college dropout with a photographic memory talks his way into a job at a top Manhattan law firm without a degree.
A crew of thieves, hackers and grifters uses its skills to take down the rich and powerful who prey on ordinary people.
A blacklisted spy stranded in Miami takes on freelance jobs helping people in trouble while hunting whoever burned him.
An FBI agent recruits his genius mathematician brother to crack cases using equations and probability.
A reclusive billionaire and an ex-CIA operative use a secret surveillance AI to prevent violent crimes before they happen.
A brilliant but volatile London detective walks a fine line between genius and self-destruction to catch the city's worst killers.
A small-town Pennsylvania detective investigates a local murder while her own life crumbles around her.
Two friends search for their long-lost college buddy, remembering how he challenged an engineering school obsessed with marks.
Three childhood friends take a bachelor road trip across Spain, each facing a fear before life pulls them apart.
Dumped days before her wedding, a sheltered young woman from Delhi goes on her honeymoon to Europe alone.
Three broke misfits stumble on a wrong-number ransom call and decide it is their ticket to quick money.
Two small-time dreamers compete to woo a rich heiress, only to discover she is not who they think.
A lovable Mumbai gangster enrols in medical school to fulfil his father's dream and shakes up the system with compassion.
A legendary concierge and his loyal lobby boy are swept into a caper over a priceless painting and a family fortune.
Framed for stealing a pop-up book, Paddington lands in prison while the Browns hunt for the real thief.
Two co-dependent high-school seniors try to score alcohol for a party before going their separate ways to college.
Three groomsmen wake up after a wild Vegas bachelor party with no memory and no sign of the groom.
A New York economics professor discovers her boyfriend belongs to one of Singapore's richest families, and his mother disapproves.
A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in a dazzling, bittersweet Los Angeles.
Two young Indians fall in love on a European trip, but she is promised to another man back in Punjab.
A heartbroken businessman's life changes when he meets a bubbly, talkative girl on an overnight train.
An American traveller and a French student meet on a train and spend one night wandering and talking through Vienna.
The spirited Elizabeth Bennet clashes with the proud Mr Darcy as her family navigates marriage, money and manners.
Two teenagers from the same Irish town drift together and apart through school and university.
A South Korean heiress paraglides into North Korea by accident and is hidden by a stern army officer who falls for her.
The eight Bridgerton siblings look for love and happiness in the glittering, gossip-fuelled London high society of the Regency era.
An eight-year-old who struggles at school is sent to boarding school, where an unconventional art teacher sees what others missed.
A banker sentenced to life for a crime he insists he did not commit forms an unlikely friendship and holds on to hope.
A kind-hearted man with a simple outlook drifts through decades of American history while loving one woman.
An ambitious young drummer is pushed to the brink by a ruthless conservatory instructor who will stop at nothing.
A former wrestler trains his daughters against all odds to become world-class champions in a village that scoffs at them.
Villagers crushed by colonial taxes accept a British officer's wager: beat his team at cricket and the tax is cancelled.
A disgraced hockey player coaches a fractious women's national team, hoping to redeem himself on the world stage.
A young man from a poor Chambal village refuses to give up on cracking India's toughest civil services exam.
The friendship and rivalry of Homi Bhabha and Vikram Sarabhai as they lay the foundations of India's nuclear and space programmes.
Two legendary revolutionaries forge an unlikely friendship in 1920s India before fate pits them on opposite sides.
A young man raised by villagers climbs a mighty waterfall and discovers his royal destiny in the kingdom of Mahishmati.
A fearless Bombay gangster infiltrates the brutal Kolar Gold Fields to assassinate its ruler and free its enslaved workers.
In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel warrior flee a tyrant in an armoured war rig, with his army in pursuit.
A retired hitman comes roaring back to settle a score with the gangsters who took everything from him.
Batman faces his greatest psychological test when the Joker unleashes anarchy on Gotham City.
After a devastating defeat, the surviving Avengers assemble one last time to undo the damage and restore the universe.
Brooklyn teen Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and teams up with Spider-People from other dimensions.
d: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey & Rodney Rothman

o: Decades after flight school, Maverick returns to train an elite squadron for a near-impossible mission.
Ethan Hunt and his IMF team race against time after a mission goes wrong and stolen plutonium goes missing.
An exiled Indian spy returns to stop a rogue mercenary group from launching a devastating attack on the country.
Noble families wage war for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient threat gathers beyond the Wall.
A group of vigilantes sets out to take down corrupt superheroes who abuse their fame and powers.
Hundreds of desperate, debt-ridden players accept an invitation to compete in children's games for a huge prize, with deadly stakes.
A lone bounty hunter in the outer reaches of the galaxy becomes protector of a mysterious child.
An English navigator shipwrecked in 1600 Japan becomes entangled in a powerful lord's fight for survival amid civil war.
A young Black man's weekend visit to his white girlfriend's family estate becomes increasingly sinister.
After the family matriarch dies, her daughter's household begins unravelling terrifying secrets about their ancestry.
Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren help a family terrorised by a dark presence in their farmhouse.
A small town is terrorised by a female spirit who abducts men at night during festival season, and a tailor sets out to stop her.
A couple moves into an ancestral palace rumoured to be haunted, and a quirky psychiatrist arrives to uncover the truth.
A family must live in near-total silence to avoid creatures that hunt by sound.
A workaholic father and his daughter fight to survive a zombie outbreak aboard a speeding bullet train.
Siblings who grew up in a famously haunted house confront the ghosts of their past, and the house itself.
A sullen ten-year-old wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse to save her parents.
A boy who dreams of becoming a musician is transported to the Land of the Dead to uncover his family's history.
The personified emotions inside an eleven-year-old's head scramble to help her cope with a big move.
A grieving widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and floats off to South America, with a stowaway scout aboard.
A young monk who can master all four elements must end a hundred-year war waged by the Fire Nation.
Humanity lives behind enormous walls to escape man-eating giants, until a boy swears revenge after the walls are breached.
A brilliant student finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it, and a genius detective sets out to catch him.
Breathtaking footage reveals how animals survive on islands, mountains, jungles, deserts, grasslands and cities.
Tech insiders explain how social platforms are engineered to capture attention, and what that does to us.
Climber Alex Honnold prepares to scale the 3,000-foot face of El Capitan without ropes or safety gear.
An inside look at Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls dynasty's final championship season.
An insurance salesman slowly realises his entire life is a TV show watched by millions.
A retired police officer hires two charming small-time crooks to capture the ruthless bandit who wronged him.
A NASA scientist returns to India to bring his childhood nanny home and finds himself transforming a remote village.
A dry-witted, grieving young woman navigates family, sex and her failing café in London while confiding in the audience.
The four adult children of a media titan scheme against each other for control of the family empire.
The reign of Queen Elizabeth II, from her young accession through decades of political and personal upheaval.
The 1986 nuclear disaster and the scientists and ordinary people who sacrificed everything to contain it.
The physicist who led the Manhattan Project grapples with the moral weight of creating the atomic bomb.
Two young brides get swapped on a crowded train, setting off a gentle comic search across rural India.
A defiant villager clashes with a forest officer while ancient spirit rituals and land feuds come to a head.
A group of friends on a trip to Kodaikanal must rescue one of their own after he falls into a deep, unexplored cave.
A righteous cop hunting a feared gangster is drawn into a series of stories that blur the line between good and evil.
Four estranged brothers living in a ramshackle house by the backwaters learn to become a family.
